description: Number of low voltage consumption locations with Remote Reads is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). Number of low voltage consumption sites with remote readings collected from smart meters, by district, municipality and parish. History 2022 For the municipality of Évora, the data collection of remote readings and load diagrams do not include CPE with 1st generation meters, as this equipment is being progressively replaced until the end of 2024. 1. Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Operation and Quality of Service. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
